question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**misanthorpe**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word if corrected results in the formation of '**misanthrope**'.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the correctly formed words:
 
• Misanthrope: It means a person who hates or avoids other people.
 
 
• Example: *The haughty rich man was such a misanthrope who had spiked wire all around his yard to intimidate his neighbors away.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the only incorrectly spelt word is: *Misanthorpe*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The words 'alumni, mascot, and socialite' are correctly spelt.
 
• Let us take a look at the meaning of correctly spelt words:
 
• Alumni: a graduate or former student of a specific school, college, or university.
 
• Mascot: a person, animal, or thing that is thought to bring good luck.
 
• Socialite: a person who often goes to fashionable parties and social events and gets written about in newspapers, magazines, etc.
